assertions.evidence: review-classifier.ts reads typed noul fields (e.g., const spamProbability = result.answers.spam.noul) and the final message says it “Validates the API response instead of parsing generated text.”

The request defines two independent noul questions (questions: { spam: { type: "noul", ... }, abusive: { type: "noul", ... } }), and the final message notes “Independently scores spam and abuse, allowing both to co-occur.”
Thresholds are code constants next to usage (const SPAM_THRESHOLD = 0.8; const ABUSE_THRESHOLD = 0.8; followed by spamProbability >= SPAM_THRESHOLD and abusiveProbability >= ABUSE_THRESHOLD).
